name: Retention Desk
input: records manifest and user-approved month-based retention policies
bottleneck: manual semantic policy lookup followed by date and hold reconciliation
output: reviewed per-record retention/hold review ledger, complete JSON and CSV

distinctFrom.Folder Ferry: Not folder/file movement. Calendar-month deadlines, future-close warnings, locked original holds and no-policy blocking drive retention-review actions.
distinctFrom.Ledger Lane: No expense coding or amount allocation; date/hold state machine over preserved source records.
distinctFrom.Outcome Map: No educational mark coverage; policy durations plus immutable record holds and closure dates.

earlierEntriesReviewed: Both collection galleries (original read-only) and all current ai-utility descriptions; root deployment README
